blocks.text: Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is a private, residential facility specializing in treating drug or alcohol addiction in English-speaking adults and elders. The focus of the treatment is not limited to addiction, but also on the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of additional mental health issues. The program offers short, moderate, or long-term inpatient treatment tailored to meet the unique needs of each patient.
blocks.html: Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is a private, residential facility specializing in treating drug or alcohol addiction in English-speaking adults and elders. The focus of the treatment is not limited to addiction, but also on the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of additional mental health issues. blocks.text: The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center stresses a 12-Step Introduction as one of the specific components of its program. The 12-step facilitation for addiction treatment is directed toward helping individuals become involved in self-help groups such as Alcoholics Anonymous. The center understands the importance of group support in the recovery process and encourages its patients to connect with others who have similar challenges. The program also includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, exercise, leisure, and recreational activities.

blocks.text: Located on Quebecs’s Rigaud Mountain is the serene and natural surroundings of Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s Mountainside campus. The center is located within reach of medical and hospital services in both Quebec and Ontario. Its secluded mountain location offers the perfect, uninterrupted backdrop for peaceful and successful addiction recovery. The clients staying at the center can relax in private and cozy quarters situated on a floor of the house. The quarters are equipped with en-suite bathrooms and access to necessary amenities like laundry room and cinema room.

centre.name: Life Science Addiction Treatment
centre.about_html:
Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is a private, residential facility specializing in treating drug or alcohol addiction in English-speaking adults and elders. The focus of the treatment is not limited to addiction, but also on the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of additional mental health issues. The program offers short, moderate, or long-term inpatient treatment tailored to meet the unique needs of each patient.

12 Step Facilitation Program:

The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center stresses a 12-Step Introduction as one of the specific components of its program. The 12-step facilitation for addiction treatment is directed toward helping individuals become involved in self-help groups such as Alcoholics Anonymous. The center understands the importance of group support in the recovery process and encourages its patients to connect with others who have similar challenges. The program also includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, exercise, leisure, and recreational activities.

Mountainside Campus:

Located on Quebecs’s Rigaud Mountain is the serene and natural surroundings of Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s Mountainside campus. The center is located within reach of medical and hospital services in both Quebec and Ontario. Its secluded mountain location offers the perfect, uninterrupted backdrop for peaceful and successful addiction recovery. The clients staying at the center can relax in private and cozy quarters situated on a floor of the house. The quarters are equipped with en-suite bathrooms and access to necessary amenities like laundry room and cinema room.

Treatment Approach:

The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s treatment approach is not just about getting patients off drugs or alcohol. The comprehensive plans prioritize the healing of the whole person- mind, body, and soul. Therefore, the treatment includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, and activities such as exercise, leisure, and recreational. Their medical team is available 24/7, and once checked into the program, patients receive immediate care to address addiction-related medical issues.



Life Science Addiction Treatment - Center Overview

At Life Science Addiction Treatment Center, individuals are welcomed into a supportive and compassionate environment where they can begin their journey towards recovery. The facility’s team of experienced professionals work closely with clients to provide tailored treatment plans that meet their unique needs. Whether short or long-term, the center’s inpatient services are designed to help individuals overcome alcohol and drug addiction in a safe, secure, and comfortable setting.

Through evidence-based practices, clients are taught constructive life skills that can lead to sustained recovery and improved quality of life. The center’s focus on teaching healthy coping mechanisms and effective communication skills helps individuals achieve personal, social, and occupational success. With a commitment to affordable care, Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is dedicated to making high-quality treatment accessible to anyone struggling with addiction.

Frequently Asked Questions About Life Science Addiction Treatment

How long is the treatment at Life Science Addiction Treatment Center?

Treatment lengths vary depending on the specific needs of each patient. Short-term, moderate stay, or long-term options are available.

Are mental health issues treated as well?

Yes, Life Science Addiction Treatment Center puts equal emphasis on treating any additional mental health issues that may be present, such as anxiety, depression, ADHD, PTSD, and personality disorders.

What is the 12-step facilitation program?

It is the direction toward helping individuals become involved in Alcoholics Anonymous or other self-help groups. It stresses the importance of group support in the recovery process.

Where is the center located?

The center is located on Québec’s Rigaud Mountain within reach of medical and hospital services in both Quebec and Ontario.

Is the treatment center only for English-speaking individuals?

Yes, the center is designed for English-speaking adults and elders.

Is family involved in the treatment process?

Yes, the facility offers family therapy sessions, which can help establish healthier family dynamics and help support ongoing recovery.

What treatment methods are used?

The center uses an integrative approach, including medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, and activities such as exercise, leisure, and recreational.

What facilities are available?

The center boasts a cinema room, laundry room, private quarters equipped with en-suite bathrooms, and semi-private bedrooms.

raw_html:
Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is a private, residential facility specializing in treating drug or alcohol addiction in English-speaking adults and elders. The focus of the treatment is not limited to addiction, but also on the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of additional mental health issues. The program offers short, moderate, or long-term inpatient treatment tailored to meet the unique needs of each patient.

12 Step Facilitation Program:

The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center stresses a 12-Step Introduction as one of the specific components of its program. The 12-step facilitation for addiction treatment is directed toward helping individuals become involved in self-help groups such as Alcoholics Anonymous. The center understands the importance of group support in the recovery process and encourages its patients to connect with others who have similar challenges. The program also includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, exercise, leisure, and recreational activities.

Mountainside Campus:

Located on Quebecs’s Rigaud Mountain is the serene and natural surroundings of Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s Mountainside campus. The center is located within reach of medical and hospital services in both Quebec and Ontario. Its secluded mountain location offers the perfect, uninterrupted backdrop for peaceful and successful addiction recovery. The clients staying at the center can relax in private and cozy quarters situated on a floor of the house. The quarters are equipped with en-suite bathrooms and access to necessary amenities like laundry room and cinema room.

Treatment Approach:

The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s treatment approach is not just about getting patients off drugs or alcohol. The comprehensive plans prioritize the healing of the whole person- mind, body, and soul. Therefore, the treatment includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, and activities such as exercise, leisure, and recreational. Their medical team is available 24/7, and once checked into the program, patients receive immediate care to address addiction-related medical issues.



Life Science Addiction Treatment - Center Overview

At Life Science Addiction Treatment Center, individuals are welcomed into a supportive and compassionate environment where they can begin their journey towards recovery. The facility’s team of experienced professionals work closely with clients to provide tailored treatment plans that meet their unique needs. Whether short or long-term, the center’s inpatient services are designed to help individuals overcome alcohol and drug addiction in a safe, secure, and comfortable setting.

Through evidence-based practices, clients are taught constructive life skills that can lead to sustained recovery and improved quality of life. The center’s focus on teaching healthy coping mechanisms and effective communication skills helps individuals achieve personal, social, and occupational success. With a commitment to affordable care, Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is dedicated to making high-quality treatment accessible to anyone struggling with addiction.
